entities.summary: Robert L. Turner is an American businessman and politician who served as the United States representative for New York's 9th congressional district from 2011 to 2013. He is a member of the Republican Party. Bob Turner was a performers & entertainers from New York City (b. 1941-05-02, New York City). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
